name: akari-dummy-view-container-fixture
description: S15 dynamic curation test fixture — a minimal VS Code extension whose 5th activity bar view container only appears ~2s after activation (via a `when` context key flipped by setContext), simulating the PoC-observed case where a partner extension's icon shows up after the initial onDidInitializeLayout curation pass has already run. Used by task 2026-07-15-shell-sa-foundation's S15 acceptance test.
